projects.title: NeuroSight – Biologically-Inspired Motion Detection
projects.summary: Built and published NeuroSight (PyPI), a biologically-accurate motion detector modeled on the Drosophila (fruit fly brain) visual system.
projects.content: Reverse-engineered T4/T5 connectome weights from Janelia connectome databases into a Hassenstein-Reichardt correlator, achieving 100% directional accuracy on synthetic benchmarks and 64+ FPS on CPU-only (no GPU/ML models). Shipped 36 unit tests with 100% cardinal direction coverage, robotics-ready abstractions (looming detection, time-to-contact estimation, collision-avoidance steering), and streaming video I/O—achieving sub-100MB runtime memory (50-100MB across CPU/RPi/phone targets vs. 1GB+ for traditional optical flow), enabling edge deployment on Raspberry Pi, mobile, and drone platforms; designed as an explainable, ML-free alternative to black-box optical flow for robotics and computer vision education.
